items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughan's bass player was in an automobile accident or something, and I got a last-minute call from I guess, Ronnell Bright (I think he was working with her), to come and fill in. So I go play with her.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm in love with it. It's really a great lyric. And also another thing, "Birds On the Wing," which I am hoping to get to Ella or Sarah. I think they might like that one. I've been writing songs most of my life, but I've been a little too shy to push them, except some of those that people just demanded that they do.
